name: Bharatiya Janata Party
founders: Atal Bihari Vajpayee, L. K. Advani and others, from the former Bharatiya Jana Sangh (founded 1951 by Syama Prasad Mookerjee)
mission: Describes its philosophy as 'Integral Humanism' (Deendayal Upadhyaya) and cultural nationalism, with a focus on development and national security.

leaders.name: Atal Bihari Vajpayee
leaders.quote: Jai Jawan, Jai Kisan, Jai Vigyan (Hail the soldier, the farmer, and science)

events.title: Bharatiya Jana Sangh founded
events.body: Syama Prasad Mookerjee founds the party that the BJP grew out of.

events.title: Merges into the Janata Party
events.body: The Jana Sangh joins other opposition parties to fight the post-Emergency election.

events.title: BJP founded
events.body: Former Jana Sangh members found the BJP; Atal Bihari Vajpayee is the first president.

events.title: First BJP government
events.body: Vajpayee becomes Prime Minister; the government lasts 13 days.

events.title: Leads the NDA government
events.body: Vajpayee becomes Prime Minister again, until 2004.

events.title: First single-party majority
events.body: With 282 seats; Narendra Modi becomes Prime Minister.

events.title: Third term, as a coalition
events.body: Wins 240 seats; leads the NDA government with its allies.

promises.text: Extend Ayushman Bharat health cover to every citizen aged 70 and above.
promises.note: Approved by the Union Cabinet in September 2024; cards issued from October 2024.

promises.text: One Nation, One Election: simultaneous elections to the Lok Sabha and assemblies.
promises.note: Constitution amendment bills introduced in December 2024 and sent to a Joint Parliamentary Committee.

promises.text: 3 crore more houses under PM Awas Yojana.
Free ration for 80 crore people for five more years.
promises.note: PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana extended for five years from January 2024.

promises.text: Keep raising minimum support prices (MSP) for major crops.
Annul Article 370 and Article 35A for Jammu and Kashmir.
promises.note: Revoked in August 2019; upheld by the Supreme Court in December 2023.
Passed in December 2019; rules notified in March 2024.

promises.text: Pass a law against triple talaq.
promises.note: Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, July 2019.

promises.text: Explore all possibilities to build the Ram temple in Ayodhya within the framework of the Constitution.
promises.note: Supreme Court verdict in November 2019; temple consecrated in January 2024.

promises.text: Piped water (Nal se Jal) to every household by 2024.
promises.note: Jal Jeevan Mission raised coverage sharply but had not reached every household by 2024.

promises.text: 33% reservation for women in Parliament and state assemblies.
promises.note: Law passed in September 2023; it takes effect only after the next census and delimitation.

promises.text: A pucca house for every family by 2022.
